name: h3map-skill benchmark suite
description: Golden renders a ported renderer must reproduce. Element coverage: coastlines, roads (junctions/diagonals), foreground/background occlusion, creatures, ocean, lava palette animation, snow terrain.
how_to_run: Render each case with YOUR renderer at the exact map/center/zoom/size/time_ms below, then: python3 compare.py your.png golden/<id>.png --out diff.png

coordinates.center: normalized to map size: world_px = center * map_size * 32
coordinates.time_ms: animation clock — palette-animated water/lava frames depend on it; keep identical or everything diffs

comparison.warn: diff < 8% — inspect the heat map; scattered blobs are random-object materialization (expected), ribbons along roads/coasts are bugs
comparison.fail: diff >= 8% or ribbon-shaped diff (see SKILL.md §5/§9 for the usual causes)

cases.verify: shore water/sand transition smooth and un-stepped; road bands continuous across tile borders; objects paint over roads
diagonal road halves connect at seams; the creature standing on the road occludes it (painter order)
crossroad halves align; big buildings occlude ground behind them; animated creature frames at time 1000ms
snow/sand/water triple transition; castle and hero anchored bottom-right on their tiles
lava palette-rotation frame matches the golden AT TIME 1000ms exactly (this is the animation-timing test)
town sprite over ground/roads (depth order); coast smooth; roads unbroken under trees
